title: A Wave From It All | 6BR Blue Mountain Beach Rental | Royal Destinations
meta_description: A Wave From It All is a 6BR Gulf front home in Old Florida Beach on 30A with private boardwalk and Gulf views. Sleeps 14. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: A Wave From It All by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 491 Old Beach Road Details: Welcome to A Wave From It All, your premier Gulf front vacation rental along scenic 30A. Located in the exclusive gated community of Old Florida Beach, this luxury six-bedroom beachfront home offers the ultimate escape on Florida’s Emerald Coast. Step inside to find a grand entryway with an expansive staircase leading to the main living area, where floor-to-ceiling views of the Gulf take center stage. The open-concept living room flows seamlessly onto a second-floor wraparound balcony, showcasing panoramic views of sugar-white sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Designed for both relaxation and entertaining, this spacious 30A beachfront home features private beach access, a newly renovated community pool, and ample space for hosting intimate events. Ideal for wedding receptions, family reunions, and small gatherings of up to 30 guests, this Gulf front rental combines elegance with functionality. Perfectly situated for outdoor enthusiasts, A Wave From It All is just a short walk to the Timpoochee Trail, a scenic 19-mile bike path stretching the length of 30A. Explore nearby coastal communities, boutique shops, and local restaurants with ease using the complimentary bikes provided. Experience the best of 30A luxury rentals, beachfront living, and unforgettable Gulf views at A Wave From It All. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Private Community Beach Access: Gulf Front - Sweeping Gulf Views Paired With Spacious Balconies - Access To Community Pool - Small Events Considered (Please contact reservations for additional fee amount.) - Walking distance to the Timpoochee Trail - Parking Spaces: 6 Spaces in Driveway - Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 12, Bar Seating for 6 - Coffee Maker Available Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 14 6 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms First Floor: - Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Two Twin Sleeper Chairs with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) - Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) - Living Area with Wet Bar Second Floor: - Bedroom 5: King Bed (Pocket Door Separating Bedroom 5 and 6) - Bedroom 6: King Bed (Pocket Door Separating Bedroom 5 and 6) - Second Floor Shared Bath with Shower - Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area - Laundry Room Amenities Include: - 4 Adult Bikes - 1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March - October Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- A Wave from It All has been a true gift to our family, welcoming us with its warmth every time we arrive. The scent of cypress and the soaring vaulted ceiling create an inviting space, while the ocean views from the main living area still take our breath away. We love gathering on the upper deck to relax, read, or watch the sunset. Though spacious, the home has the cozy charm of a classic Florida beach house, nestled in the peaceful, gated Old Florida Beach community—complete with a pool, beach access, and scenic paths along Draper Lake. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
